episodes.title: Welcome to Republic City
episodes.summary: The series premiere of this cartoon about a bold and rebellious teenage girl who undergoes training to become a fully realized Avatar, Korra arrives in Republic City and discovers it's a dangerous place for benders.

episodes.title: A Leaf in the Wind
episodes.summary: Korra is thrilled to discover the city's Pro-bending Arena, where she meets two brothers who compete there.

episodes.title: The Revelation
episodes.summary: Korra tries to gain access to the Equalist movement and its secretive leader.

episodes.title: The Voice in the Night
episodes.summary: A task force recruits Korra to help them with their violent plan to remove Equalists.

episodes.title: The Spirit of Competition
episodes.summary: Romantic rivalries disrupt the harmony on Korra's team.

episodes.title: And the Winner is...
episodes.summary: Korra prepares for the pro-bending championship while a sense of danger hovers over the arena.

episodes.title: The Aftermath
episodes.summary: Korra worries that a friend is secretly aligned with the Equalists.

episodes.title: When Extremes Meet
episodes.summary: Korra quarrels with Councilman Tarrlok in the midst of growing Equalist activity.

episodes.title: Out of the Past
episodes.summary: Korra tries to analyze the mysterious visions she's been having. Meanwhile, Tenzin and Beifong look for Equalist hostages.

episodes.title: Turning the Tides
episodes.summary: Republic City gets bombarded by the Equalists.

episodes.title: Skeletons in the Closet
episodes.summary: Korra goes undercover and learns a secret while her teammates go after the enemies' stronghold.

episodes.title: Endgame
episodes.summary: Korra confronts the enigmatic ruler of the Equalists.

episodes.title: Rebel Spirit
episodes.summary: Korra attends the Southern Water Tribe Festival, where she tries to connect to the spirit world.

episodes.title: The Southern Lights
episodes.summary: Korra she enters a violent maelstrom and discovers a source of spiritual power.

episodes.title: Civil Wars (1)
episodes.summary: Part 1 of 2. Korra tries to be impartial as tension rises between the northern and southern tribes.

episodes.title: Civil Wars (2)
episodes.summary: Korra's folks are wrongfully incarcerated, so Korra fights to free them.

episodes.title: Peacekeepers
episodes.summary: Korra reaches a dead end when she turns to the president for help, so she strikes out on her own.

episodes.title: The Sting
episodes.summary: Future Industries may close up shop because of the threat Triad poses, so Mako does some research and stumbles upon a huge conspiracy at work.

episodes.title: Beginnings (1)
episodes.summary: The origins of the first Avatar are revealed to Korra.

episodes.title: Beginnings (2)
episodes.summary: Korra sets out to restore balance between the physical and spirit worlds.

episodes.title: The Guide
episodes.summary: Tenzin's assistance is sought by Korra as she prepares to enter the Spirit World for the first time.

episodes.title: A New Spiritual Age
episodes.summary: Korra arrives in the Spirit World, where she has difficulty forging connections with the spirits.

episodes.title: Night of a Thousand Stars
episodes.summary: Bolin proves to be a hero when President Raiko is attacked.

episodes.title: Harmonic Convergence
episodes.summary: Korra tries to seal the spirit portals prior to Harmonic Convergence.

episodes.title: Darkness Falls
episodes.summary: Unalaq's scheme has a twist uncovered by Korra. Meanwhile, Tenzin must deal with his demons if he wants to rescue his daughter.

episodes.title: Light in the Dark
episodes.summary: Korra learns of a method she can employ to attempt to destroy the dark spirit.

episodes.title: A Breath of Fresh Air
episodes.summary: In the third-season opener, Korra uncovers a huge shift in the bending world, which is the result of Harmonic Convergence.

episodes.title: Rebirth
episodes.summary: Air Nation is revived thanks to Korra and Team Avatar.

episodes.title: The Earth Queen
episodes.summary: The team look for Airbenders on a trip to Ba Sing Se.

episodes.title: In Harm's Way
episodes.summary: Korra wants to free Airbenders in Be Sing Se who are being forced to join the Earth Queen's army.

episodes.title: The Metal Clan
episodes.summary: Korra and her pals arrive in the metal city of Zaofu.

episodes.title: Old Wounds
episodes.summary: Beifong confronts her past.

episodes.title: Original Airbenders
episodes.summary: New members receive training from Tenzin, who must also deal with Bumi's poor attitude.

episodes.title: The Terror Within
episodes.summary: Zaheer and his crew try to kidnap Korra.

episodes.title: The Stakeout
episodes.summary: Zaheer reveals the goals of the Red Lotus to Korra while his allies close in on her.

episodes.title: Long Live the Queen
episodes.summary: Korra and Asami escape and return to the oasis, so Zaheer takes his anger out on the Earth Queen as the Red Lotus destroy the city.

episodes.title: The Ultimatum
episodes.summary: Korra contacts Tenzin as the Red Lotus attack the temple, so Tenzin and his siblings try to fight off the invaders.

episodes.title: Enter the Void
episodes.summary: Zaheer removes the hostages from the temple as Korra prepares to sacrifice herself for the other airbenders.

episodes.title: Venom of the Red Lotus
episodes.summary: The Red Lotus poison Korra, who takes to the skies to battle Zaheer.

episodes.title: After All These Years
episodes.summary: Kai and Opal try to assist a struggling community in Earth Kingdom three years after Team Avatar was poisoned by Zaheer.

episodes.title: Korra Alone
episodes.summary: Avatar Korra may have escaped Republic City, but she can't seem to escape her past.

episodes.title: The Coronation
episodes.summary: There's only one thing Prince Wu is looking forward to more than ruling the Earth Kingdom, his PARTY!

episodes.title: The Calling
episodes.summary: Pema and Tenzin's kids leave their home to find Korra.

episodes.title: Enemy at the Gates
episodes.summary: Kuvira travels to the city of Zaofu to negotiate with Suyin Beifong. Zaofu is the last city in the Earth Kingdom not under Kuvira's rule.

episodes.title: The Battle of Zaofu
episodes.summary: Korra and Kuvira face off in an epic showdown.

episodes.title: Reunion
episodes.summary: Korra returns to Republic City, but Kuvira'a actions spoil her homecoming.

episodes.title: Remembrances
episodes.summary: Korra goes to Zaheer in order to face her inner fears and find balance within herself.

episodes.title: Beyond the Wilds
episodes.summary: Jinora gets trapped in the Spirit World and Korra mounts a rescue mission, but she's halted by Zaheer's apparition.

episodes.title: Operation Beifong
episodes.summary: Bolin assists Opal and Lin in rescuing the Beifongs. Meanwhile, Korra searches for help in the Spirit World.

episodes.title: Kuvira's Gambit
episodes.summary: Korra and the gang attempt to halt Kuvira's actions against Republic City. Meanwhile, Kuvira reveals a new lethal weapon in her arsenal.

episodes.title: Day of the Colossus
episodes.summary: Team Avatar battle Kuvira in the heart of Republic City, and innocent bystanders are evacuated by Pema and Prince Wu.

episodes.title: The Last Stand
episodes.summary: Korra faces off with Kuvira, and the fate of many hangs in the balance.
